note: Declared, reasoned exceptions where productCatalog.status deliberately disagrees with the measured release. NOT a way to silence the gate — each entry states why and what would retire it.

3d.reason: The published build is a UI scaffold — its own release notes say '3D viewport placeholder'. An installable artifact exists, but advertising it as a product would oversell a shell.
3d.retireWhen: 3D ships a build that renders real geometry; then set status/delivery to match and drop this entry.

architect.reason: Same shape — release notes describe a 'workspace UI' with a '3D viewport placeholder'. Scaffold, not product.
architect.retireWhen: Architect ships real CAD/BIM behaviour behind the UI.

engine.reason: Release notes describe an 'editor scaffold'. No runtime, physics or multiplayer behind it yet.
engine.retireWhen: Engine ships a build that can actually run a scene.
